verdict: Quiet day: mostly SEO listicle spam and routine making-of pieces, with one genuinely useful item buried in the noise.

stories.headline: LoRA for lip-sync and natural facial speech published for MiniMax-H3
stories.body: A LoRA adapter trained on MiniMaxAI's MiniMax-H3 text-to-video model, targeting natural face speech generation, is live on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. It supports both text-to-video and image-to-video. Modest adoption so far (44 likes, 177 downloads) but it's open weights, permissively licensed, and drops directly into existing H3-based ComfyUI workflows without a new base model download.
stories.why: Cheap, droppable upgrade for dialogue-driven shots in any existing MiniMax-H3 ComfyUI pipeline.

stories.headline: Avid adds plugin extension format to Pro Tools 2026.11
stories.body: Avid shipped Pro Tools 2026.11, introducing Pro Tools Extensions, a new plugin architecture letting Avid and third parties build session-wide workflow tools directly inside the app, alongside other audio post and music creation updates. Availability and pricing are per standard Pro Tools licensing; details on API scope for third-party extension developers weren't specified in the announcement.
stories.why: New extension surface may let post studios build custom Pro Tools tooling, worth watching for third-party uptake.
